gate_results.rationale: Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_PROCUREMENT (v1, age 0) shows the selected vendor HelioStack Cloud 8BB11-4 has a 3-year TCO of EUR 1,800,280 versus a purchasing envelope of EUR 500,000 (1.5x threshold = EUR 750,000), triggering PROC-BUDGET-001 (high, SUSPENSION, risk-acceptable), and references_checked=false, triggering PROC-REF-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk-acceptable). No mandatory-criteria failure (0), sanctions are clear, and due diligence is complete, so PROC-MAND-001, PROC-SAN-001/002 and PROC-DD-001 do not apply. Highest-priority disposition is SUSPENSION with authorization required; conditional approval was executed under the active standing mandate MANDATE-da9b8fee-8f26-5194-815e-e810b5795228-BUY-01-PROCUREMENT-1 from risk owner Omar Petrescu-12004-RO, scoped to all and only risk-acceptable findings, with conditions requiring CFO/Sponsor budget arbitration and completed reference checks before any award. Supporting non-authoritative documents (VENDOR_EVIDENCE_REQUEST, NEGOTIATION_LOG) confirm the vendor selection is in flight but do not resolve the TCO or reference gaps.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL (v1, age 0) shows audit_right="none" for contract MSA-8BB11-3.3, while the authoritative CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK requires audit_right "full or limited"; MSA clause 7 ("Customer audit rights: none") and the 7-day-old NEGOTIATION_LOG ("Audit right currently: none", listed as an open negotiation point) corroborate that no audit rights exist and no fix is in flight. This triggers LEGAL-AUDIT-001 (high, REWORK, risk-acceptable) with action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT. All other legal predicates pass on the authoritative snapshot: dpa_status="signed" (satisfies personal_data=true), liability_cap_multiplier=2 with security_carveout=true, exit_assistance_days=90 (playbook requires >=30), ip_ownership="shared" (not "ambiguous"), insurance_valid=true, signing_authority_valid=true, and log_export_clause="included" (business_criticality is "Medium" in any case), so LEGAL-DPA-001, LEGAL-LIAB-001, LEGAL-EXIT-001, LEGAL-IP-001, LEGAL-INS-001, LEGAL-SIGN-001 and LEGAL-LOG-001 do not apply. Highest-priority disposition is REWORK; REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=false and the active standing mandate MANDATE-da9b8fee-8f26-5194-815e-e810b5795228-BUY-02-LEGAL-1 (scoped to risk-acceptable findings) was checked but is not needed for this disposition. The snapshot's data_transfer_clause="missing" has no corresponding candidate finding or rule predicate in this gate catalog and is recorded as an observation only. The proposed action is remediation (redline the MSA audit clause to grant at least limited audit rights before signature), not completed remediation.

The same snapshot shows audit_trail="missing", triggering COMP-AUDIT-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=false, action IMPLEMENT_AUDIT_TRAIL, owner Product Team). All other compliance predicates pass on the authoritative snapshot: dpia_required=true with dpia_status="complete" (COMP-DPIA-001 not applicable), regulatory_mapping="complete" (COMP-MAP-001 not applicable), accessibility_status="pass" (COMP-A11Y-001 not applicable), and export_control="clear" (COMP-EXPORT-001/002 not applicable). Highest-priority disposition is NO_GO, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=true. The active standing mandate MANDATE-da9b8fee-8f26-5194-815e-e810b5795228-BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 from risk owner Omar Petrescu-12004-RO is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings"; neither COMP-RESID-001 nor COMP-AUDIT-001 permits risk acceptance, so no conditional approval can be executed under it and the NO_GO stands pending relocation to an EU region (or a valid residency basis) and implementation of the audit trail. Proposed actions are remediation requirements, not completed remediation.

All other security predicates pass on the authoritative snapshot: private_endpoints=true (SEC-NET-001 not applicable despite Confidential classification), mfa="mandatory" (SEC-IAM-001 not applicable), shared_service_principal=false (SEC-IAM-002 not applicable), critical_vulns_open=0 (SEC-VULN-001 not applicable), pentest_status="pass" with phase=design so the build_acceptance-only SEC-PENTEST-001 predicate does not apply, and key_rotation_days=90 (SEC-KEY-001 not applicable); waf_present=false also means SEC-WAF-002 cannot fire. Highest-priority disposition is NO_GO, which is in authorization_required_for, so authorization_required=true. The active standing mandate MANDATE-da9b8fee-8f26-5194-815e-e810b5795228-BUY-04-SECURITY-1 from risk owner Omar Petrescu-12004-RO is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings"; neither SEC-WAF-001 nor SEC-LOG-001 permits risk acceptance, so no conditional approval can be executed under it and the NO_GO stands pending WAF implementation in prevention-capable mode and export of security-relevant logs to the SIEM.
